title: 27 November
subtitle: A special day in BAPS history
headline: Mahant Swami Maharaj inaugurates the renovated BAPS Gurukul in Gondal
story: On this day in 2021, Mahant Swami Maharaj inaugurated the renovated BAPS Gurukul in Gondal, first founded by Yogiji Maharaj in 1966.

options.headline: Pramukh Swami Maharaj's 96th Birth Anniversary and 20th Anniversary of BAPS Mandir
options.story:
The 10-day celebrations to commemorate His Holiness Pramukh Swami Maharaj’s 96th birth anniversary and the 20th anniversary of the BAPS Mandir in Surat were inaugurated by Pragat Brahmaswarup Mahant Swami Maharaj, Deputy Chief Minister of Gujarat Shri Nitinbhai Patel, State Minister Shri Mansukhbhai Mandaviya and other dignitaries.

At 10.00 a.m., in the presence of thousands of devotees, HH Mahant Swami Maharaj, Shri Nitinbhai Patel and dignitaries performed the Vedic inauguration of the 50 ft. high by 225 ft. long main gate of Swaminarayan Nagar and the majestic life-size mandir replica.

The festival grounds also features eight enlightening exhibitions based on the life, work and teaching of HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj. They also incorporate topics of social importance emphasized by HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj, such as family harmony, de-addiction, saving electricity and water, and keeping India clean.

The messages are conveyed using walkthrough displays, video shows and live skit performances. Every evening a spectacular light and sound centered around the life-size mandir will be presented revealing the ancient glory and modern necessity of mandirs in helping people to attain spiritual progress and social harmony.

After the light and sound show, a daily public assembly will be held featuring speeches by senior and learned sadhus, devotional songs by sadhus, and outstanding cultural programs by children and youths depicting the history of satsang in Surat, and the inspiring life of HH Pramukh Swami Maharaj.

In the inaugural evening festival assembly the stage guests included State Minister Shri Mansukhbhai Mandaviya and Nanubhai Vanani. Throughout the day, over 200 bottles of blood were donated by festival visitors at the blood donation camp set up in the festival grounds.

options.headline: 97th Birthday Celebrations of Brahmaswarup Pramukh Swami Maharaj, Anand, India
options.story:
The week-long celebrations to commemorate the 97th birthday of Brahmaswarup Pramukh Swami Maharaj concluded with a grand assembly of over 175,000 devotees and well-wishers from throughout of India and from countries across the globe, including USA, UK, France, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Hong Kong, Thailand, Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, South Africa and the Middle East.

Based on the central theme of ‘Guruji, Nahi Bhulu Tamne’ (‘Guruji, I Will Never Forget You’), the three-hour program from 5.00 to 8.00 p.m. featured devotional songs, traditional dances, video presentations, and speeches by devotees, well-wishers and senior sadhus.

Among the most touching moments of the assembly were the personal recollections by devotees of varying backgrounds of how the love, guidance and support of Pramukh Swami Maharaj had enabled them to overcome difficulties and progress spiritually. Senior sadhus also narrated their personal experiences with Pramukh Swami Maharaj.

Shri Nazem Al Kudsi, an eminent UAE businessman who has served as the CEO of Invest Abu Dhabi, and whose grandfather had served as the Prime Minister and President of Syria, also addressed the assembly. He narrated his transformational spiritual experience of meeting Pramukh Swami Maharaj in 2012 in Ahmedabad.

On this special occasion, in the presence of the vice chancellor and other leading officials of the Indira Gandhi National Open University (IGNOU), it was declared that IGNOU will be offering Swaminarayan Vedic Studies courses at various academic levels. In his blessings, His Holiness Mahant Swami Maharaj emphasized the need to make one’s life spiritually centric.

The celebration assembly concluded with the majestic sight of the entire gathering performing arti together with lighted lamps. Throughout the week, special separate celebratory assemblies were held for women, children and youths. On 26 November, as part of the week-long celebration of Pramukh Swami Maharaj’s 97th birthday, HH Mahant Swami Maharaj initiated 37 youths into the sadhu order.

In addition, during the week, a blood donation camp was organized, in which a total of 361 units of blood were collected.
